title: Japan Just Built an AI That Beats GPT-5.5 Without Being an AI
description:
Everyone's arguing about who has the strongest AI. Japan just asked a different question.

Sakana AI's new tool, Fugu, isn't trying to be the smartest model in the room — it's trying to be the smartest manager of models. It picks the right AI for each part of a task, runs them in parallel, and merges the results. On one of the hardest coding benchmarks out there, it beat GPT 5.5 by 15 points.

The catch: those numbers are self-reported, and real-world testers say it's inconsistent. But the idea underneath it — AIs working as a team instead of one giant brain — might matter more than the scoreboard.


#AI #ContentMarketing #SakanaAI #MultiAgentAI  #aitools
